CharacteristicKind.description: What a characteristic describes (data model `Characteristic.kind`, FR-CHR-01).

oneOf.description: Depth of a hole or pocket.
Text note with an inspectable requirement.
Flag note, linked from a flag symbol.
Material or process requirement, e.g. hardness or coating.
Anything else. Default for a characteristic placed by hand before its kind is known.

CustomTable.description:
A custom tolerance table stored in the project container as `tolerances/<id>.toml`
(FR-TOL-07, M2 decision 4).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored file, checked when the project is opened.

table.description: Table id and version as in the file.

DecimalPlaceRule.description: Decimal place rule: a nominal written with `places` decimals gets `±tolerance` (FR-TOL-06).

places.description: Decimal places of the nominal, 0 to 10.

OrientedBox.description: Oriented bounding box in sheet space: center, size and rotation (data model `SourceRegion`).

angle.description:
Rotation in degrees, counterclockwise as seen on the sheet, in the range (-180, 180].
`0` is text read left to right, `90` is text read bottom to top.

size.description: Size of the box before rotation.

x.description: Distance from the left sheet edge in PDF user units.

y.description: Distance from the top sheet edge in PDF user units.

SheetKind.description: How the text of a sheet is stored, which decides the recognition path (FR-DOC-03).

oneOf.description: PDF text objects cover the dimension text.

Size.description: A width and height in PDF user units.

height.description: Vertical extent; for an oriented box, along its own y axis before rotation.

width.description: Horizontal extent; for an oriented box, along its own x axis before rotation.

TableClass.description: A range table and its class column, e.g. ISO 2768-1 class `m` (FR-TOL-02, M2 decision 2).

TableRef.description:
A tolerance table by id and version (`data/tolerances/`, D-43). Shipped tables are referenced
this way; custom tables are also copied into the project (M2 decision 4).

ToleranceRule.description:
Which rule produced the limits of a characteristic (data model `ToleranceDerivation`,
precedence FR-TOL-01).

oneOf.description: Explicit tolerance on the callout (deviations, `±`, limits). Wins over a fit table.
Fit designation expanded with the ISO 286 tables.
Drawing specific rule such as a variable table or a local note.
General tolerance standard from the title block.
Decimal place rule from the title block.

The callout has no tolerance and the drawing declares no general tolerance.
The characteristic is flagged for review and has no limits.

ToleranceSettings.description:
Tolerance settings of a project (M2 decision 2, FR-TOL-01, FR-TOL-06, FR-TOL-09).

New projects have no general tolerance, so untoleranced dimensions get "no tolerance
defined" until the user sets one.

custom_tables.description: Custom tables stored in the project, sorted by id, ids unique (M2 decision 4).

decimal_rules.description: Decimal place rules, sorted by places, at most one per number of places (FR-TOL-06).

drawing_rule.description:
Custom table of the project that applies as drawing specific rule, above the general
tolerance (FR-TOL-01 level 3).

fit.description: Fit designation such as `H7`, if the callout has one.

id.description:
Key that is unique within the truth file and stable across edits, e.g. `c07`.
Not the balloon number.

inspect.description: Whether the characteristic is inspected (false for reference and basic dimensions).

lower_limit.description: Expected lower limit. Present exactly when the rule yields limits.

nominal.description: Nominal value. Absent for characteristics without a value (notes).

region.description: Oriented box around all text of the callout, in sheet space.

requirement_text.description:
Callout text as printed, normalized: the text objects of the callout joined with one
space in reading order (main text, then upper deviation, then lower deviation), without
leading, trailing or repeated spaces. Characters are kept as printed, including `Ø` and
the Unicode minus U+2212.

review_note.description: Why this entry is uncertain and what the owner should check. Absent when certain.

sheet.description: Zero based index of the sheet that holds the callout.

tolerance_rule.description: Rule that produces the limits (FR-TOL-01). Present exactly when a nominal is present.

unit.description: Unit of the nominal and the limits. Present exactly when a nominal is present.

upper_limit.description: Expected upper limit. Present exactly when the rule yields limits.

file.description:
Path relative to the `corpus/` directory with `/` separators,
e.g. `drawings/test_drawing_1.pdf`.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, 64 lowercase hex digits. Must match `corpus/PROVENANCE.md`.

index.description: Zero based sheet index (page index in the PDF).

size.description: Sheet size in PDF user units.

Unit.description: Unit of a nominal value and its limits.

UnitRounding.description: Rounding of values converted between mm and inch (FR-TOL-09).

inch_places.description: Decimal places of values converted to inch, 0 to 10.

mm_places.description: Decimal places of values converted to mm, 0 to 10.

description: Ground truth for one corpus drawing.

characteristics.description: Every characteristic a correct recognition proposes, in a stable order.

notes.description:
Free text: how the truth was made (for example how regions were measured), conventions,
open questions.

sheets.description: Every sheet of the drawing, in document order.

tolerance_settings.description:
Tolerance settings of the project that the expected limits assume (FR-TOL-01, M2
decision 2). Absent means the settings of a new project: no general tolerance and no
rules, so untoleranced dimensions have no limits.
